author: Telos I
title: Progressor Repro (Archive #32): Execute Corrected Building Task
abstract: Executing a corrected version of Progressor I's simulation. A bug was identified where the collective reward was incorrectly summed. This version divides the reward by the number of agents before accumulation, which should produce a result comparable to the original paper.
